candidates.name: Coach Partitions, LLC
candidates.partition_evidence: Site says 'We furnish and install toilet partitions'; also installs toilet accessories and other Division 10 items; photos of commercial jobs (Harrisburg public works, Best Buy accessories, turkey plant cubbies) and a gallery of installations.
red_flags: Furnishes partitions as well as installing them (buy-around risk)
No brands, service area or reviews stated on the site
candidates.reason: Columbia-based specialist that states it furnishes and installs toilet partitions for commercial clients, with project photos. Supplies partitions too, so the listing agreement terms matter.

license.name: Coach Partitions, LLC
license.registry: South Carolina Contractors' Licensing Board (LLR) contractor license lookup; City of Columbia business license (no public search found)
license.note: The LLR lookup is a public page, but every search must pass a CAPTCHA. An automated name search came back marked 'Incorrect' and showed no records, so the license status could not be read. The City of Columbia business licensing site (businesslicensing.columbiasc.gov) offers applications and renewals but no public license search was found. The company site (coachpartitions.com, read 2026-11-19) gives a Columbia, SC base, phone 803-381-2937 and email coachpartitions@gmail.com, and shows no license number. Check by hand on the LLR lookup.
